_about: Episode queue. The pipeline takes the first item with status 'idea', writes an episode spec from it, renders, publishes, and sets status. Lessons are the themes that performed best on the channels studied (sharing, safety, hygiene, routines, kindness). Lanes: story = 25-45s lesson; song = 10-20s counting/rhyme loop; slapstick = no-dialogue 15-30s gag.

items.premise: Pip has three cookies, Biscuit stares with puppy eyes; she shares one and they both get a bigger smile.
Biscuit hides Pip's toothbrush at bedtime; she shows him the brushing song and he brushes his own fake teeth.
items.gimmick: each brush stroke plays the next note

items.premise: The ball rolls toward the road, Biscuit wants to chase it; Pip holds his collar and they wait for the green man.
items.gimmick: traffic light beeps are the beat

items.premise: Muddy paws and muddy hands after the garden; bubbles everywhere as they wash for a whole song.
items.gimmick: every bubble pop is a note

items.premise: Cupcakes in the oven; Biscuit keeps trying to open the oven door, Pip teaches him to count down with the timer.
items.gimmick: timer ticks become the countdown melody

items.premise: A vase falls while Biscuit plays; Pip is blamed, Biscuit brings the broken piece to Grandma Rosie himself.
Biscuit won't sleep; Pip does bath, pyjamas, story, and he's snoring before the last page.
items.gimmick: each routine step is a chord of a lullaby

items.premise: The playroom is a mess and Pip can't find her teddy; they race to tidy and find it in the last box.
items.gimmick: each toy into the box is a note

items.premise: Pip refuses broccoli, Biscuit pretends it's a tiny tree and the dinosaur eats it; she tries it and likes it.
Pip snatches a toy from Milo, he cries; she gives it back, says sorry, and they play together.
A baby bird falls from the nest; Pip and Biscuit gently help Grandma Rosie put it back.
items.gimmick: the bird's chirps answer the music

items.premise: Pip can't ride her scooter; she falls, tries again three times, and zooms on the fourth.
items.gimmick: each try is a key change up

items.premise: Beach day; Biscuit gets a pink nose, Pip shares her sunscreen and hat.
At the grocery store Biscuit wanders off chasing a balloon; Pip shows him to stay by the cart.
Grandma Rosie's laundry basket is too heavy; Pip and Biscuit carry the socks one by one.
items.gimmick: every sock is a note, they pair up into harmony

items.premise: Pip has a cold but wants to play; Biscuit brings her a blanket and soup, and she feels better tomorrow.
Biscuit wins the race to the tree; Pip feels grumpy, then high-fives him and they race again.
Pip, Milo and Biscuit all want the slide; they take turns and each turn is louder and happier.
items.gimmick: each slide is a rising glissando
items.status: made as PB002 (ball version: my turn, your turn)

items.premise: Pip leaves the tap running while brushing; Biscuit turns it off and they water a plant with the saved cup.
Five blocks, one per beat, Pip counts and Biscuit yips each number.
Paint splats: red, yellow, blue, then they mix into orange, green, purple.
Biscuit tries to moo, quack and oink before landing on 'woof!'.
Circle, square, triangle pop out of the toy box and stack into a house.
items.gimmick: each shape has its own instrument

items.premise: Seven socks on a washing line, one per day, Biscuit steals Sunday.
Biscuit vs a bouncing bubble: it keeps escaping, it lands on his nose.
Pip's giant sneeze blows every toy across the room.
items.gimmick: the sneeze build-up is a riser

items.premise: Biscuit tries to catch his own tail in faster and faster circles until he's dizzy.
items.gimmick: tempo speeds up with the spin

items.premise: Pip and Biscuit copy each other's dance moves, each move bigger.
A paper plane loops around the room and lands in Biscuit's water bowl.
items.gimmick: the plane's path draws the melody
